topic: Gandalf with a lightsaber, Death Star over Mordor
new_body_text: Gandalf with a lightsaber. Death Star over Mordor. **Both made by one person.**
new_caption:
Two of the biggest stories ever told, stitched into one world by a single person.

Gandalf with a lightsaber shouldn't look this natural. The Death Star over Mordor shouldn't make this much sense. But here we are — the era where 'what if' is just a render away.
